segments.iti31:2.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco katakalyāṇo hoti, katakusalo, katabhīruttāṇo, akatapāpo, akataluddo, akatakibbiso.
segments.iti31:2.4: So ‘kataṃ me kalyāṇan’ tipi na tappati,‘akataṃ me pāpan’ tipi na tappati.
segments.iti31:2.5: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā atapanīyā”ti.
segments.iti31:4.3: Kāyassa bhedā sappañño, saggaṃ so upapajjatī”ti.
segments.iti31:5.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
